bio_en: Arshak Hovhannisian was born in Nukhi in 1883, studied pedagogy in Moscow and graduated from the commercial institute in Kiev. A veteran of the ARF, he was minister of agriculture in the last government of the independent Republic of Armenia. In February 1921 he was one of the leaders of the uprising against Soviet rule and the military head of the Salvation Committee. In emigration he was active in Lebanon in the ARF, the Hamazkayin society and Armenian community bodies, and he died suddenly of a heart attack on 1 April 1953 at the age of 70.
